s.d: δεσμο-φύλαξ, -κος, ὁ (δεσμός, φύλαξ), a prison-keeper, gaoler: [[acts 16 23|Act.16:23, 27, 36]] (cf. ἀρχιδ-, [[genesis 39 21|Gen.39:21]]).† (AS)
δεσμωτήριον, -ου, τό [in LXX for בֵּית סֹהַר (Ge), אָסִיר ;] a prison: [[matthew 11 2|Mat.11:2]], [[acts 5 21|Act.5:21, 23 16:26]].† (AS)
δεσμώτης, -ου, ὁ [in LXX for אסר, מַסְגֵּר ;] a prisoner: [[acts 27 1|Act.27:1, 42]].† (AS)

δεσπότης, -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for אָדוֹן, אֲדֹנָי; in Jdth.9:17, δ. τ. οὐρανῶν κ. τ. γῆς]; a master, lord, correlative of δοῦλος, οἰκέτης: [[1-timothy 6 1|1Ti.6:1]], 2, [[2-timothy 2 21|2Ti.2:21]], [[titus 2 9|Tit.2:9]], [[1-peter 2 18|1Pe.2:18]]; as title of God, voc., δέσποτα (so usually in LXX), [[luke 2 29|Luk.2:29]], [[acts 4 24|Act.4:24]]; ὁ δ. = voc. δέσποτα (cf. B1., § 33, 4), [[revelation 6 10|Rev.6:10;]] of Christ, [[2-peter 2 1|2Pe.2:1]], Ju 4, R, txt. (but cf. mg.).† SYN.: κύριος (which see), implying limitation of authority and a more general relation than δ., which "denoted absolute ownership and uncontrolled power" (Thayer). (AS)

δεῦρο adv., [in LXX chiefly for לֵךְ, לֵכָה ;] 1. of place; (a) hither, with verbs of motion; (b) (in cl. chiefly poët.) as an imperat., here! come!: [[matthew 19 21|Mat.19:21]], [[mark 10 21|Mrk.10:21]], [[luke 18 22|Luk.18:22]], [[john 11 43|Jhn.11:43]], [[acts 7 3|Act.7:3]]" (LXX) , 34 (LXX), [[revelation 17 1|Rev.17:1 21:9]]. 2. Of time, hitherto, now: [[revelation 1 13|Rev.1:13.]]† (AS)

δεῦτε adv., as pl. of δεῦρο, 1. (b), which see, [in LXX chiefly for לְכוּ ;] come on! come here! come!: with imperat., [[matthew 25 34|Mat.25:34 28:6]], [[john 4 29|Jhn.4:29 21:12]], [[revelation 19 17|Rev.19:17]]; with subjc., [[matthew 21 38|Mat.21:38]], [[mark 12 7|Mrk.12:7]]; before ὀπίσω, [[matthew 4 19|Mat.4:19]], [[mark 1 17|Mrk.1:17]]; πρός, [[matthew 11 28|Mat.11:28;]] εἰς, [[matthew 22 4|Mat.22:4]], [[mark 6 31|Mrk.6:31]].† (AS)
δευτεραῖος, -α, -ον (δεύτερος), adj. with adverbial sense; on the second day: δευτεραῖοι ἤλθομεν, [[acts 28 13|Act.28:13.]]† (AS)

δευτερό-πρωτος, -ον second first (in what sense, there is no satisfactory explanation. The reading is prob. not original, see ICC, in l.; DCG, i, 411; ii, 541, 724): [[luke 6 1|Luk.6:1]], WH, mg., R, mg.† (AS)

δεῦτερος, -α, -ον, second in order, with or without idea of time: [[matthew 22 26|Mat.22:26, 39]], al.; θάνατος, [[revelation 2 11|Rev.2:11 20:14 21:8]]; χάρις, [[2-corinthians 1 15|2Co.1:15.]] In neut. as adv., secondly, a second time; opposite to πρῶτον: [[john 3 4|Jhn.3:4 21:16]], [[1-corinthians 12 28|1Co.12:28]], [[revelation 19 3|Rev.19:3]]; τὸ δ., [[2-corinthians 13 2|2Co.13:2]], Ju 5; ἐν τ. δ., at the second time: [[acts 7 13|Act.7:13;]] in later usage (as 1Ma.9:1), ἐκ δ., [[mark 14 72|Mrk.14:72]], [[john 9 24|Jhn.9:24]], [[acts 11 9|Act.11:9]], [[hebrews 9 28|Heb.9:28]]. (AS)

δέχομαι, depon. mid., [in LXX chiefly for לקח ;] to receive, accept; 1. with accusative of thing(s), of taking or accepting what is offered: γράμματα, [[luke 16 6|Luk.16:6]], 7; id. in different sense, [[acts 28 21|Act.28:21;]] ποτήριον, [[luke 22 17|Luk.22:17;]] παιδίον (εἰς τ. ἀγκάλας), [[luke 2 28|Luk.2:28;]] περικεφαλαίαν, μάχαιραν, [[ephesians 6 17|Eph.6:17;]] ἐπιστολάς, [[acts 22 5|Act.22:5;]] τ. βασιλείαν τ. Θεοῦ, [[mark 10 15|Mrk.10:15]], [[luke 18 17|Luk.18:17]]; λογία ζῶντα, [[acts 7 38|Act.7:38;]] εὐαγγέλιον, [[2-corinthians 11 4|2Co.11:4;]] τ. χάριν τ. Θεοῦ, [[2-corinthians 6 1|2Co.6:1;]] metaphorically, of mental acceptance, [[matthew 11 14|Mat.11:14;]] τ. λόγον, [[luke 8 13|Luk.8:13]], [[acts 8 14|Act.8:14 11:1 17:11]], [[1-thessalonians 1 6|1Th.1:6 2:13]], [[james 1 21|Jas.1:21]]; τὰ τ. πνεύματος, [[1-corinthians 2 14|1Co.2:14;]] τ. παράκλησιν, [[2-corinthians 8 17|2Co.8:17;]] τ. ἀγάπην τ. ἀληθείας, [[2-thessalonians 2 10|2Th.2:10.]] 2. with accusative of person(s), of receiving kindly or hospitably, [[matthew 10 14|Mat.10:14 40, 41]], [[mark 6 11|Mrk.6:11]], [[luke 9 5|Luk.9:5 53 10:8, 10]], [[john 4 45|Jhn.4:45]], [[2-corinthians 7 15|2Co.7:15 11:16]], [[galatians 4 14|Gal.4:14]], [[colossians 4 10|Col.4:10]], [[hebrews 11 31|Heb.11:31]]; παιδίον, [[matthew 18 5|Mat.18:5]], [[mark 9 37|Mrk.9:37]], [[luke 9 48|Luk.9:48]]; εἰς οἴκους, σκηνάς, [[luke 16 4|Luk.16:4]], 9; δέξαι τ. πνεῦμά μου, [[acts 7 59|Act.7:59;]] ὃν δεῖ οὐρανὸν δέασθαι, [[acts 3 21|Act.3:21]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο, δια-, εἰσ-, ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, παρα-, προσ-, ὑπο-δέχομαι; Cremer, 174).† (AS)

δέω (I), [in LXX chiefly for אסר ;] to tie, bind, fasten; (1) with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς δεσμάς, [[matthew 13 30|Mat.13:30;]] of an ass, [[matthew 21 2|Mat.21:2]], [[mark 11 2|Mrk.11:2]], 4 [[luke 19 30|Luk.19:30]]. (2) with accusative of person(s), of swathing a dead body, ὀθονίοις, [[john 19 40|Jhn.19:40;]] δεδομένος τ. πόδας . . . κειρίαις (Bl., §34, 6; Kühner 3, iii, 125), [[john 11 44|Jhn.11:44;]] of binding with chains, ἀγγέλους, [[revelation 9 14|Rev.9:14;]] a demoniac, πέδαις κ. ἁλύσεσι, [[mark 5 3|Mrk.5:3]], 4; captives, [[matthew 12 29|Mat.12:29 14:3 22:13 27:2]], [[mark 3 27|Mrk.3:27 6:17 15:1, 7]], [[john 18 12|Jhn.18:12, 24]], [[acts 9 2|Act.9:2, 14, 21, 21:11, 13 22:5, 29 24:27]], [[colossians 4 3|Col.4:3]], [[revelation 20 2|Rev.20:2]]; ἁλύσεσι, [[acts 12 6|Act.12:6 21:33]]. Metaphorical, ὁ λόγος τ. Θεοῦ, [[2-timothy 2 9|2Ti.2:9;]] of Satan binding by disease (MM, see word), [[luke 13 16|Luk.13:16;]] of constraint or obligation, [[acts 20 22|Act.20:22;]] of the marriage bond, [[1-corinthians 7 39|1Co.7:39;]] id. with dative of person(s), ἀνδρί, [[romans 7 2|Rom.7:2;]] γυναικί, [[1-corinthians 7 27|1Co.7:27;]] in Rabbinic lang. (Dalman, Words, 213f.), to forbid, declare forbidden, [[matthew 16 19|Mat.16:19 18:18]] (cf. κατα-, περι-, συν-, ὐπο-δέω; Cremer, 82). † (AS)

δή consecutive co-ordinating particle with no exact equiv. in Eng., giving greater exactness and emphasis to the word or words to which it is attached; sometimes translatable as now therefore, then, verily, certainly. 1. With verbs: imperat., [[acts 6 3|Act.6:3]] (WH, mg.) 13:2, [[1-corinthians 6 20|1Co.6:20]]; hort. subjc., [[luke 2 15|Luk.2:15]], [[acts 15 36|Act.15:36]]; indic., δή που (Τ, δήπου, which see), [[hebrews 2 16|Heb.2:16.]] 2. With pronouns: ὃ δή, now this is he who, [[matthew 13 23|Mat.13:23.]]† (AS)

δῆλος, -η, -ον [in LXX for אוּר, etc. ;] 1. visible. 2. clear to the mind, evident: [[matthew 26 73|Mat.26:73;]] δ. (sc. ἐστίν), before ὅτι, [[1-corinthians 15 27|1Co.15:27]], [[galatians 3 11|Gal.3:11]].† SYN.: φανερός, with ref. to outward appearance, manifest as opposite to concealed; δ. with ref. to inner perception, evident, known, under­stood. (AS)

δηλόω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for ידע ;] to make plain, declare: with accusative, [[1-corinthians 3 13|1Co.3:13]], [[colossians 1 8|Col.1:8]], [[hebrews 9 8|Heb.9:8 12:27]]; with dative of person(s), [[2-peter 1 14|2Pe.1:14;]] with dative of person(s), before περί (pass.), [[1-corinthians 1 11|1Co.1:11;]] before εἰς, [[1-peter 1 11|1Pe.1:11.]]† SYN.: ἐμφανίζω, to make manifest, render visible to the sight; δ. to render evident to the mind. (AS)
Δημᾶς, ὁ (perh. contracted from Δημήτριος), Demas, a companion of St. Paul: [[colossians 4 14|Col.4:14]], Phm 24, [[2-timothy 4 10|2Ti.4:10]].† (AS)
δημηγορέω, -ῶ (δῆμος, ἀγορεύω, to speak in the assembly), [in LXX: [[proverbs 24 66|Pro.24:66]] (30:31), 4Ma.5:15 * ;] to deliver an oration: [[acts 12 21|Act.12:21.]]† (AS)
Δημήτριος, -ου, ὁ Demetrius; 1. a silversmith, [[acts 19 24|Act.19:24 38]]. 2. A Christian disciple, III Jn 12.† (AS)

δημιουργός, -οῦ, ὑ (δῆμος, ἔργον), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:1 * ;] 1. one who works for the people. 2. Univ., an author, builder, maker; the maker of the world (Xen., Mem., I, 4, 9, al.), [[hebrews 11 10|Heb.11:10.]]† SYN.: κτίστης, creator, τεχνίτης, craftsman, designer. In He, l.with, τ. has reference to the plan, δ. to its execution. (AS)

δῆμος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּחָה ;] 1. a district, country. 2. the common people, the people generally; esp. the people assembled: [[acts 12 22|Act.12:22 17:5 19:30 33]]. † SYN.: λαός, the people at large: δ., the people as a body politic; opposite to δ. is ὄχλος, the unorganized multitude. ἔθνος, in sing., means in NT as in Gk. writers generally, a nation, but in pl. denotes the rest of mankind apart from the Jews: Gentiles. λ. also, rare in cl. (Att... λεώς), is frequently in LXX and NT, and usually limited to the chosen people, Israel (cf. Cl. Rev., i, 42 f.; Cremer, 689). (AS)

δημόσιος, -α, -ον (δῆμος), [in LXX: 2Ma.6:10, 3Ma.2:27 4:7 * ;] belonging to the people, public: [[acts 5 18|Act.5:18;]] dative fem. used adverbially (cl.); (a) at the public expense, by public consent; (b) publicly: [[acts 16 37|Act.16:37 18:28 20:20]].† (AS)

δηνάριον, -ου, τό the Lat. denarius, a Roman coin, nearly equal to the δραχμή, which see: [[matthew 18 28|Mat.18:28 20:2, 9, 13 22:19]], [[mark 6 37|Mrk.6:37 12:15 14:5]], [[luke 7 41|Luk.7:41 10:35 20:24]], [[john 6 7|Jhn.6:7 12:5]], [[revelation 6 6|Rev.6:6]]; τὸ ἀνὰ δ., [[matthew 20 10|Mat.20:10.]]† (AS)
δή-ποτε indef. adv. (also written δή ποτε), with generalizing force; 1. absol., sometime. 2. With adv. or relat., -soever: ᾦ δ., [[john 5 4|Jhn.5:4]] (L, οἱῳδηποτοῦν).† (AS)
δή-που (WH, δή που), indef. adv., mostly in sense of surely, of course, we know: [[hebrews 2 16|Heb.2:16]] T (WH, δή που).† (AS)

διά (before a vowel δ᾽, exc. [[romans 8 10|Rom.8:10]], [[2-corinthians 5 7|2Co.5:7]], and in (Proper name)s; Tdf., Pr., 94), prep. with genitive, accusative, as in cl.; 1. with genitive, through; (i) of Place, after verbs of motion or action: [[matthew 2 12|Mat.2:12 12:43]], [[mark 2 23|Mrk.2:23]], [[luke 4 30|Luk.4:30]], [[john 4 4|Jhn.4:4]], [[2-corinthians 11 33|2Co.11:33]], al.; σώζεσθαι (διας-) δ. πυρός, ὕδατος, [[1-corinthians 3 15|1Co.3:15]], [[1-peter 3 20|1Pe.3:20]]; βλέπειν δ. ἐσόπτρου, [[1-corinthians 13 12|1Co.13:12;]] metaphorically, of a state or condition: [[romans 14 20|Rom.14:20]], [[2-corinthians 2 4|2Co.2:4 5:7]], 10; δ. γράμματος, ἀκροβυστίας (Lft., Notes, 263, 279), [[romans 2 27|Rom.2:27 4:11]]; δι ̓ὑπομενῆς, [[romans 8 25|Rom.8:25.]] (ii) Of Time; (a) during which: [[matthew 26 61|Mat.26:61]], [[mark 14 58|Mrk.14:58]], [[luke 5 5|Luk.5:5]]; δ. παντὸς τοῦ ζῆν, [[hebrews 2 15|Heb.2:15;]] δ. παντός (διαπαντός in [[mark 5 5|Mrk.5:5]], [[luke 24 53|Luk.24:53]]), always, continually, [[matthew 18 10|Mat.18:10]], [[acts 2 25|Act.2:25]]" (LXX) 10:2 24:16, [[romans 11 10|Rom.11:10]]" (LXX), [[2-thessalonians 3 16|2Th.3:16]], [[hebrews 9 6|Heb.9:6 13:15]]. (b) within which: [[acts 1 3|Act.1:3;]] δ. νυκτός, [[acts 5 19|Act.5:19 16:9 17:10 23:31]]; (with) after which (Field, Notes, 20; Abbott, JG, 255f.): [[mark 2 1|Mrk.2:1]], [[acts 24 17|Act.24:17]], [[galatians 2 1|Gal.2:1]]. (iii) Of the Means or Instrument; (1) of the efficient cause (regarded also as the instrument): of God, [[romans 11 36|Rom.11:36]], [[1-corinthians 1 9|1Co.1:9]], [[galatians 4 7|Gal.4:7]], [[hebrews 2 10|Heb.2:10 7:21]]; of Christ, [[romans 1 8|Rom.1:8 5:1, 17]], [[1-corinthians 15 21|1Co.15:21]], [[1-peter 4 11|1Pe.4:11]], al.; δ. τ. ὑμῶν δεήσεως, [[romans 1 12|Rom.1:12]], [[2-corinthians 1 4|2Co.1:4]], [[galatians 4 23|Gal.4:23]], al.; (2) of the agent, instrument or means; (a) with genitive of person(s), [[matthew 11 2|Mat.11:2]], [[luke 1 70|Luk.1:70]], [[john 1 17|Jhn.1:17]], [[acts 1 16|Act.1:16]], [[romans 2 16|Rom.2:16]], [[1-corinthians 1 21|1Co.1:21]], [[ephesians 1 5|Eph.1:5]], [[hebrews 2 14|Heb.2:14]], [[revelation 1 1|Rev.1:1]], al.; ὑπὸ τ. κυρίου δ. τ. προφήτου (δ. τ. κυρίου, [[1-thessalonians 4 2|1Th.4:2]] (M, Th., in l.); Lft., Rev., 121f.), [[matthew 1 22|Mat.1:22 2:15]], [[romans 1 2|Rom.1:2]]; δ. ἐπιστολῆς ὡς δ. ἡμῶν (Field, Notes, 202), [[2-thessalonians 2 2|2Th.2:2;]] δ. Σ. (NTD, 22), [[1-peter 5 12|1Pe.5:12;]] (b) with genitive of thing(s) (where often the simple dative is used in cl.; Jannaris, Gr., 375), [[john 11 4|Jhn.11:4]], [[acts 5 12|Act.5:12]]; δ. τ. πίστεως, [[romans 3 30|Rom.3:30;]] δ. λόγου θεοῦ, [[1-peter 1 23|1Pe.1:23;]] δ. παραβολῆς, [[luke 8 4|Luk.8:4;]] δουλεύειν δ. τ. ἀγάπης, [[galatians 5 13|Gal.5:13;]] δ. ἐπαγγελίας, [[galatians 3 18|Gal.3:18]], 2. C. accusative; (i) rarely, as with genitive, through (Hom), δ. μέσον Σαμαρίας (ICC, in l.; Bl., §42, 1; Robertson, Gr., 581), [[luke 17 11|Luk.17:11.]] (ii) by reason of, because of, for the sake of; (a) with accusative of person(s) (M, Pr., 105), [[mark 2 27|Mrk.2:27]], [[john 6 57|Jhn.6:57 11:42]], [[romans 8 20|Rom.8:20]]; (b) with accusative of thing(s), δ. φθόνον, [[matthew 27 18|Mat.27:18]], [[mark 15 10|Mrk.15:10]]; δ. φόβον, [[john 7 13|Jhn.7:13 20:19]]; δ. ἀγάπην, [[ephesians 2 4|Eph.2:4;]] δ. τοῦτο, freq., for this cause, therefore, [[matthew 6 25|Mat.6:25]], [[mark 6 14|Mrk.6:14]], [[luke 11 49|Luk.11:49]], [[john 6 65|Jhn.6:65]], al.; id. before ὅτι, [[john 5 16|Jhn.5:16 10:17]], al.; δ. τί, why, [[matthew 9 11|Mat.9:11, 14]] [[mark 2 18|Mrk.2:18]], [[john 7 45|Jhn.7:45]], al.; δ. τό, with inf., [[mark 5 4|Mrk.5:4]], [[luke 9 7|Luk.9:7]], [[james 4 2|Jas.4:2]]. 3. In composition, (1) through, as in διαβαίνω; (2) of separation, asunder, as in διασπάω; (3) of distribution, abroad, as in διαγγέλλω; (4) of transition, as διαλλάσσω; (5) of "perfective" action (M, Pr., 112f., 115f.), as διαφύγω, διακαθαρίζω. (AS)

δια-βαίνω [in LXX chiefly for עבר ;] 1. to make a stride. 2. to step across, cross over; (a) trans.: τ. θάλασσαι, [[hebrews 11 29|Heb.11:29;]] (b) intrans.: before εἰς, [[acts 16 9|Act.16:9;]] πρός, [[luke 16 26|Luk.16:26.]]† (AS)

δια-βάλλω [in LXX: Dan LXX 3:8, [[daniel 3 8|Da TH 3:8; 6:24]] (25) (אֲכַל קְרַץ), 2Ma.3:11, 4Ma.4:1 * ;] 1. to throw across. 2. To slander, defame, accuse falsely or maliciously: [[luke 16 1|Luk.16:1]] (Cremer, 120).† (AS)
δια-βεβαιόομαι, -οῦμαι to affirm confidently: [[titus 3 8|Tit.3:8;]] before περί, [[1-timothy 1 7|1Ti.1:7]] (Cremer, 140).† (AS)

δια-βλέπω 1. to took straight before one. 2. to see clearly: [[matthew 7 5|Mat.7:5]], [[mark 8 25|Mrk.8:25]], [[luke 6 42|Luk.6:42]] (cf. διάβλεψις, Aq., [[isaiah 61 1|Isa.61:1]], for LXX ἀνάβ-).† (AS)

διάβολος, -ον (διαβάλλω, which see) [in LXX for שָׂטָן (as [[job 1 6|Job.1:6]]), exc. [[esther 7 4|Est.7:4 8:1]] (צַר, צָרַר) ;] slanderous, accusing falsely. As subst., ὁ, ἡ, δ.; (a) generally (of. Es, ll. with), a slanderer, false accuser: [[1-timothy 3 6|1Ti.3:6]], 7 (CGT, in l., but see infr.) 3:11, [[2-timothy 3 3|2Ti.3:3]], [[titus 2 3|Tit.2:3]]; (b) as chiefly in LXX, of Satan, the Accuser, the Devil: [[matthew 4 1|Mat.4:1, 5, 8, 11 13:39 25:41]], [[luke 4 2|Luk.4:2, 3, 6, 13 8:12]], [[john 13 2|Jhn.13:2]], [[acts 10 38|Act.10:38]], [[ephesians 4 27|Eph.4:27 6:11]], [[1-timothy 3 6|1Ti.3:6]], 7 (but see supr.), [[2-timothy 2 26|2Ti.2:26]], [[hebrews 2 14|Heb.2:14]], [[james 4 7|Jas.4:7]], [[1-peter 5 8|1Pe.5:8]], Ju 9, [[revelation 2 10|Rev.2:10 12:9, 12 20:2, 10]]; εἶναι ἐκ τοῦ δ., [[john 8 44|Jhn.8:44]], [[1-john 3 8|1Jn.3:8]]; τέκνα τοῦ δ., [[1-john 3 10|1Jn.3:10;]] υἱὸς, [[acts 13 10|Act.13:10;]] metaphorically, of Judas, [[john 6 70|Jhn.6:70]] (Cremer, 121; DCG, ii, 605).† (AS)
δι-αγγέλω [in LXX for ספר pi., etc. ;] to publish abroad, proclaim: with accusative, [[luke 9 60|Luk.9:60]], [[acts 21 26|Act.21:26]], [[romans 9 17|Rom.9:17]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

δια-γίνομαι (Ion. and late Gk. for διαγίγν-), [in LXX, 2Ma.11:26 * ;] 1. to go through, to pass, e.g. τ. νύκτα; absol., to live. 2. Of time, to intervene, elapse: ptcp., with ἡμερῶν τινῶν, [[acts 25 13|Act.25:13;]] ἱκανοῦ χρόνου, [[acts 27 9|ib. 27:9]]; τ. σαβάτου, [[mark 16 1|Mrk.16:1.]]† (AS)

δια-γινώσκω (see previous word), [in LXX chiefly for ידע, and cf. 2Ma.9:15 ;] 1. to distinguish, ascertain exactly: [[acts 23 15|Act.23:15]] 2. As Athen. law-term, to determine: τὰ καθ᾽ ὑμᾶς, your case, [[acts 24 22|Act.24:22]] (Cremer, 673).† (AS)
δια-γνωρίζω to publish abroad: [[luke 2 17|Luk.2:17]], Rec. (ἐγνώρισεν, Edd.).† (AS)

διά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ (διαγιγνώσκω), [in LXX: Wis.3:18 * ;] 1. a distinguishing, also as medical term. 2. As law-term (Lat. cognitio), determination, decision: [[acts 25 21|Act.25:21]] (Cremer, 674).† (AS)
δια-γογγύζω [in LXX chiefly for לין, לון, as [[exodus 16 2|Exo.16:2]], and cf. Si 34(31):24 ;] of a number, to murmur or mutter among themselves: [[luke 15 2|Luk.15:2 19:7]].† (AS)
δια-γρηγορέω, -ῶ (a) prop., to remain awake (R, mg.); (b) to be fully awake (R, txt.): [[luke 9 32|Luk.9:32.]]† (AS)
δι-άγω [in LXX for עבר hi., etc. ;] 1. to carry over. 2. Of time, to pass: βίον, [[1-timothy 2 2|1Ti.2:2;]] absol., to live, before ἐν, [[titus 3 3|Tit.3:3.]]† (AS)
δια-δέχομαι [in LXX for מִשְׁנֶה (Deiss., BS, 115), פַּרְבָּר ;] to receive through another, receive in turn: [[acts 7 45|Act.7:45]] (RV, in their turn; see Field, Notes, 116).† (AS)

διάδημα, -τος, τό (διαδέω, to bind round), [in LXX for כֶּתֶר (as [[esther 1 11|Est.1:11]]), etc. ;] the band round the τιάρα of a Persian king; a diadem, the badge of royalty: [[revelation 12 3|Rev.12:3 13:1 19:12]].† SYN.: στέφανος, the badge of "victory, of valour, of nuptial joy, of festal gladness " (but see M, Th., i, 219; cf. DB, i, 530, 604). (AS)

δια-διδωμι [in LXX for חלק pi., etc. ;] 1. to hand over, deliver: [[revelation 17 13|Rev.17:13]], Rec. 2. to distribute: [[luke 11 22|Luk.11:22 18:22]], [[john 6 11|Jhn.6:11]], [[acts 4 35|Act.4:35]]† (AS)

διά-δοχος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ (διαδέχομαι), [in LXX: [[1-chronicles 18 17|1Ch.18:17]] (לְיַד), [[2-chronicles 26 11|2Ch.26:11]] (שַׂר) 28:7 (מִשְׁנֶה), Sir.46:1 48:8, 2Ma.4:29 14:26 * ;] a successor: [[acts 24 27|Act.24:27]] (for usage in LXX and π. in sense of court official, see Deiss., BS, 115).† (AS)

διαθήκη, -ης, ἡ (διατίθημι), [frequently in LXX, and nearly always for בְּרִית ;] 1. as usually in cl., a disposition, testament, will (Plat., al.): [[galatians 3 15|Gal.3:15]] (R, mg., but see Lft., in l.), [[hebrews 9 16|Heb.9:16, 17]] (R, txt.; MM, Exp., xi; Milligan, NTD, 75; Abbott, Essays, 107; Deiss., LAE, 341; but see infr.). 2. [[romans 9 4|Rom.9:4]], [[galatians 4 24|Gal.4:24]], [[ephesians 2 12|Eph.2:12]].† (AS)
δι-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ (διαιρέω), [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲלֹקֶת ;] 1. a distinction, diference. 2. a division, distribution: [[1-corinthians 12 4|1Co.12:4-6]] (cf. διαιρέω; Cremer, 616).† (AS)

δι-αιρέω, -ῶ [in LXX for בּתר (as [[genesis 15 10|Gen.15:10]]), חלק (as [[joshua 18 5|Jos.18:5]]), etc. ;] 1. to divide into parts, cut asunder. 2. to distribute: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), [[luke 15 12|Luk.15:12]], [[1-corinthians 12 11|1Co.12:11]].† (AS)
δια-καθαρίζω = θαίρω: [[matthew 3 12|Mat.3:12.]]† δια-καθαίρω, to cleanse thoroughly: [[luke 3 17|Luk.3:17.]]† (AS)
δια-κατ-ελέγχομαι to confute completely: [[acts 18 28|Act.18:28.]]† (AS)

C. accusative of thing(s), to minister, supply, supply by ministration: [[1-peter 1 12|1Pe.1:12 4:10]]; pass., [[2-corinthians 3 3|2Co.3:3 8:19, 20]].† SYN.: λειτουργέω, which see (Cremer, 179). (AS)

διακονία, -ας, ἡ (διάκονος), [in LXX for נַעַר, שָׁרַת pi.: [[esther 6 3|Est.6:3]], [[esther 6 5|Est.6:5]] A; 1Ma.11:58 * ;] the office and work of a διάκονος, service, ministry; (a) of domestic duties (Field, Notes, 63): [[luke 10 40|Luk.10:40]] (b) spec. of religious ministration, and the exercise of ministerial functions in the Church: [[acts 1 17|Act.1:17, 25 6:1, 4 11:29 12:25 20:24; 21:19]], [[romans 11 13|Rom.11:13 12:7 15:31]], [[1-corinthians 16 15|1Co.16:15]], [[2-corinthians 4 1|2Co.4:1 6:3 8:4 9:1, 13]], [[ephesians 4 12|Eph.4:12]], [[colossians 4 17|Col.4:17]], [[1-timothy 1 12|1Ti.1:12]], [[2-timothy 4 5|2Ti.4:5, 11]], [[hebrews 1 14|Heb.1:14]], [[revelation 2 19|Rev.2:19]]; δ. τ. θανάτου, [[2-corinthians 3 7|2Co.3:7;]] τ. πνεύματος, [[2-corinthians 3 8|2Co. 3:8]]; τ. κατακρίσεως, τ, δικαιοσύνης, [[2-corinthians 3 9|2Co. 3:9]]; τ. καταλλαγῆς, [[2-corinthians 5 18|2Co. 5:18]]; τ. λειτουργίας, [[2-corinthians 9 12|2Co. 9:12]]; with obj. genitive, τὴν ὑμῶν δ., [[2-corinthians 11 8|ib. 11:8]]; pl., [[1-corinthians 12 5|1Co.12:5.]]† (AS)

διάκονος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ (derivation unknown), [in LXX for נַעַר, שָׁרַת pi.: [[esther 6 3|Est.6:3]], 5, א B [[esther 1 10|Est.1:10 2:2]], [[proverbs 10 4|Pro.10:4]], 4Ma.9:17 * ;] 1. in general, a servant, attendant, minister: [[matthew 20 26|Mat.20:26 22:13 23:11]], [[mark 9 35|Mrk.9:35 10:43]], [[john 2 5|Jhn.2:5]], 9, [[1-corinthians 3 5|1Co.3:5]], [[galatians 2 17|Gal.2:17]], [[ephesians 6 21|Eph.6:21]], [[colossians 4 7|Col.4:7]]; δ. θεοῦ, [[romans 13 4|Rom.13:4]], [[2-corinthians 6 4|2Co.6:4]], [[1-thessalonians 3 2|1Th.3:2]]; δ. Χριστοῦ, [[2-corinthians 11 23|2Co.11:23]], [[colossians 1 7|Col.1:7]], [[1-timothy 4 6|1Ti.4:6]]; cf. ὁ δ. ὁ ἐμός, [[john 12 26|Jhn.12:26;]] δ. περιτομῆς, [[romans 15 8|Rom.15:8;]] δ. καινῆς διαθήκης, [[2-corinthians 3 6|2Co.3:6;]] δ. δικαιοσύνης, [[2-corinthians 11 15|2Co.11:15;]] δ. [εὐαγγελίου], [[ephesians 3 7|Eph.3:7]], [[colossians 1 23|Col.1:23]]; δ. [ἐκκλησίας], [[colossians 1 25|Col.1:25.]] 2. As technical term for Church officer (so in pre-Christian times, see M, Th., I, 32), a deacon: [[philippians 1 1|Php.1:1]], [[1-timothy 3 8|1Ti.3:8, 12]]; fem. (cf. [[1-timothy 3 11|1Ti.3:11]], and CGT, in l., also M, Th., l.with).† SYN.: δοῦλος, bondman; θεράπων, servant acting voluntarily; ὑπηρέτης, servant, attendant, by etymol. suggesting subordination. Cf. also λειτουργός, a public servant, in which the idea of service to the community is prominent; οἰκέτης, a house servant. (AS)
διακόσιοι, -αι, -α two hundred: [[mark 6 37|Mrk.6:37]], and al. (AS)

δι-ακούω [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 1 16|Deu.1:16]] (שׁמע), [[job 9 33|Job.9:33]] (יָד שִׁית hi.)* ;] to hear through, hear fully; technically, to hear judicially (as De, l.with; of. Deiss., BS, 230): [[acts 23 35|Act.23:35.]]† (AS)

δια-κρίνω [in LXX for שׁפט, דִּין, etc. ;] 1. to separate, hence, to distinguish, discriminate, discern: μηδὲν δ., [[acts 11 12|Act.11:12;]] οὐδὲν δ. μεταξύ, [[acts 15 9|Act.15:9;]] σε, [[1-corinthians 4 7|1Co.4:7;]] τὸ σῶμα, [[1-corinthians 11 29|1Co.11:29.]] 2. to settle, decide, judge, arbitrate: [[matthew 16 3|Mat.16:3]], [[1-corinthians 6 5|1Co.6:5 11:29]] (ICC, in l.), ib. 31 14:29. Hellenistic (NT and Eccl., but not LXX), to be divided in one's mind, to hesitate, doubt: [[matthew 21 21|Mat.21:21]] [[romans 14 23|Rom.14:23]], [[james 1 6|Jas.1:6]]; ἐν ἐαυτῷ, [[james 2 4|Jas.2:4;]] ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, [[mark 11 23|Mrk.11:23;]] μηδὲν δ., [[acts 10 20|Act.10:20;]] δ. τ. ἀπιστίᾳ, [[romans 4 20|Rom.4:20]], Ju 22 (R, txt.).† (AS)

διά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ (διακρίνω) [in LXX for מִפְלָשׂ, [[job 37 16|Job.37:16]] * ;] the act of judgment, discernment: [[romans 14 1|Rom.14:1]], [[1-corinthians 12 10|1Co.12:10]], [[hebrews 5 14|Heb.5:14]].† (AS)
δια-κωλεύω [in LXX: Jdth.4:7 12:7 * ;] to hinder, prevent: with accusative, [[matthew 3 14|Mat.3:14.]]† (AS)
δια-λαλέω, -ῶ [in Sm.: [[psalms 51 16|Ps 50(51):16]], and al. ;] 1. to talk with: πρός, [[luke 6 11|Luk.6:11.]] 2. to talk over: pass., [[luke 1 65|Luk.1:65.]]† (AS)

δια-λέγομαι (mid. of διαλέγω, to pick out, distinguish, as depon.), [in LXX: [[exodus 6 27|Exo.6:27]], [[isaiah 63 1|Isa.63:1]] (דּבר pi.), [[judges 8 1|Jdg.8:1]] (ריב), 1Es.8:46, [[esther 5 2|Est.5:2]], Sir.14:20, 2Ma.11:20 * ;] to converse with, discourse (see Cl. Rev., i, 45), discuss, argue: [[acts 18 4|Act.18:4 19:8,9 20:9]]; with dative of person(s), [[acts 17 17|Act.17:17 18:19 20:7]], [[hebrews 12 5|Heb.12:5]]; before πρός, [[mark 9 34|Mrk.9:34]], [[acts 17 17|Act.17:17 24:12]]; περί [[acts 24 25|Act.24:25]], Ju 9; ἀπὸ τ. γραφῶν, [[acts 17 2|Act.17:2.]]† (AS)
δια-λείπω [in LXX for יחל (as [[1-samuel 10 8|1Ki.10:8]]), etc. ;] to intermit, leave off for a time: [[luke 7 45|Luk.7:45.]]† (AS)

As in Polyb. and later writers, the language or dialect of a particular country or district: [[acts 1 19|Act.1:19 2:6, 8 21:40 22:2 26:14]].† (AS)

δι-αλλάσσω [in LXX: [[1-samuel 29 4|1Ki.29:4]] (רָצָה hithp.), I [[esther 4 31|Est.4:31]], al. ;] 1. to change, exchange. 2. to change enmity for friendship, to reconcile: pass., with dative of person(s), [[matthew 5 24|Mat.5:24.]] "The word denotes mutual concession after mutual hostility, an idea absent from καταλλ-," which see (Lft., Notes, 288; cf. δια-λογίζομαι, depon. [in LXX chiefly for חשׁב, frequently in Pss. ;] 1. to balance accounts (Dem.). 2. to consider, reason (Isocr.): [[luke 1 29|Luk.1:29 5:21]]; ἐν τ. καρδία, [[mark 2 6|Mrk.2:6]], 8, [[luke 5 22|Luk.5:22]]; περί [[luke 3 15|Luk.3:15;]] ἐν ἑαυτῷ (-οῖς), [[matthew 16 7|Mat.16:7-8]], [[mark 2 8|Mrk.2:8]], [[luke 12 17|Luk.12:17]]; πρὸς ἑ., [[mark 9 33|Mrk.9:33 11:31]], [[luke 20 14|Luk.20:14]]; παρ᾽ ἑ., [[matthew 21 25|Mat.21:25]] (ἐν ἑ., T, WH, mg.); πρὸς ἀλλήλους, [[mark 8 16|Mrk.8:16;]] ὅτι, [[mark 8 17|Mrk.8:17]], [[john 11 50|Jhn.11:50]], Rec. (DB, i, 611; Cremer, 400).† (AS)

δια-λογισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (διαλογίζομαι) [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲשָׁבָה ;] a thought, reasoning, inward questioning: [[matthew 15 19|Mat.15:19]], [[mark 7 21|Mrk.7:21]], [[luke 2 35|Luk.2:35 5:22 6:8 9:46, 47 24:38]], [[romans 1 21|Rom.1:21 14:1]], [[1-corinthians 3 20|1Co.3:20]]" (LXX), [[philippians 2 14|Php.2:14;]] κριταὶ δ. πονηρῶν, genitive of qual. δια-λύω [in LXX for אבה, חבל, etc. ;] to part asunder, dissolve; of an assembly, pass., to disperse: [[acts 5 36|Act.5:36.]]† (AS)

δια-μαρτύρομαι, depon., of Ionic origin, intensive of the simple μαρτύρομαι, which see, [in LXX chiefly for עוּד hi., usually with dative of person(s), [[deuteronomy 4 26|Deu.4:26 8:19]], [[1-samuel 8 9|1Ki.8:9]], al. ;] solemnly to protest: [[luke 16 28|Luk.16:28]], [[acts 2 40|Act.2:40 8:25 10:42 18:5 20:21, 23, 24 23:11 28:23]], [[1-thessalonians 4 6|1Th.4:6]], [[hebrews 2 6|Heb.2:6]]; in adjuration, before ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, [[1-timothy 5 21|1Ti.5:21]], [[2-timothy 2 14|2Ti.2:14 4:1]] (Cremer, 415).† (AS)
δια-μάχομαι [in LXX for לחם ni., Dan LXX 10:20; Sir.8:1, 3 38:28 51:19 * ;] 1. to struggle against. 2. In argument, to contend: [[acts 23 9|Act.23:9.]]† (AS)
δια-μένω [in LXX for עמד, etc.;] to remain, continue: [[luke 1 22|Luk.1:22 22:28]], [[galatians 2 5|Gal.2:5]], [[hebrews 1 11|Heb.1:11]]" (LXX), [[2-peter 3 4|2Pe.3:4.]]† (AS)

δια-μερίζω [in LXX chiefly for חלק pi. ;] 1. to distribute: with dative of person(s), [[acts 2 45|Act.2:45;]] before εἰς, [[luke 22 17|Luk.22:17]], pass., [[acts 2 3|Act.2:3.]] Mid. to distribute among themselves: [[matthew 27 35|Mat.27:35]], [[mark 15 24|Mrk.15:24]], [[luke 23 34|Luk.23:34]]; with redundant ἑαυτοῖς, [[john 19 24|Jhn.19:24]] (LXX) (see M, Pr., 157). 2. to divide, separate: pass., before ἐπί, with accusative, [[luke 11 17|Luk.11:17-18;]] ἐπί, with dative, [[luke 12 52|Luk.12:52-53.]]† (AS)
δια-μερισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (διαμερίζω), [in LXX: [[ezekiel 48 29|Eze.48:29]] (מַחֲלֹקֶת), [[micah 7 12|Mic.7:12]] * ;] a division: opposite to εἰρήνη, [[luke 12 51|Luk.12:51.]]† (AS)
δια-νέμω [in LXX for חלק, [[deuteronomy 29 25|Deu.29:25]] * ;] to distribute, divide: pass., to be spread about, [[acts 4 17|Act.4:17.]]† (AS)
δια-νεύω [in LXX: [[psalms 35 19|Ps 34(35):19]] (קרץ), Sir.27:22 * ;] to wink at, nod to, beckon to: [[luke 1 22|Luk.1:22.]]† (AS)
δια-νόημα, -τος, τό (διανοέομαι, to think), [in LXX for מַחֲשָׁבָה, etc., [[isaiah 55 9|Isa.55:9]], al., frequently in Sir ;] a thought: [[luke 11 17|Luk.11:17.]]† (AS)

διάνοια, -ας, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for לֵב, לֵבָב ;] the understanding, mind: [[luke 1 51|Luk.1:51]], [[ephesians 4 18|Eph.4:18]], [[colossians 1 21|Col.1:21]], [[1-peter 1 13|1Pe.1:13]], [[2-peter 3 1|2Pe.3:1]], [[1-john 5 20|1Jn.5:20]]; pl., [[ephesians 2 3|Eph.2:3;]] in quotations from LXX, [[matthew 22 37|Mat.22:37]], [[mark 12 30|Mrk.12:30]], [[luke 10 27|Luk.10:27]], [[hebrews 8 10|Heb.8:10 10:16]] (Cremer, 79, 438).† (AS)

δι-αν-οίγω [in LXX for פֶּטֶר (Ex, Nu), פָּקַח, פָּתַח, etc. ;] to open up completely, to open: [[luke 2 23|Luk.2:23]] (LXX); pass., [[mark 7 34|Mrk.7:34]], [[acts 7 56|Act.7:56]]. δια-νυκτερεύω (cf. διημερεύω, to pass the day) [in LXX: [[job 2 9|Job.2:9]] * ;] to pass the night: before ἐν τ. προσευχῆ, [[luke 6 12|Luk.6:12.]]† (AS)

δι-ανύω [in LXX: 2Ma.12:17 * ;] 1. to accomplish fully, finish, complete: [[acts 21 7|Act.21:7]] (EV). 2. In late writers (Xen., al., Clem., I ad Cor., xxv, 3), to continue: Ac, l.with (Field, Notes, 134f.).† (AS)
